services.desc: Explore the world of Taekwondo at Chung's Taekwondo. Our martial arts classes for adults, teens, and kids are designed to build confidence, strength, and discipline. Whether you're a beginner or looking to refine your skills, our structured curriculum offers something for everyone. With dedicated classes for different age groups, including engaging martial arts classes for adults, we ensure a fun and effective learning experience for all. Join us today to start your journey in Taekwondo and achieve your personal goals! Taekwondo is a great way to build confidence, strength and fitness. services.name: After School Program
services.desc: Discover the ultimate after-school solution with our Taekwondo program! We provide shuttle service, engaging taekwondo classes, and a safe, fun environment for your child. Incorporating activities, our program ensures kids stay active while learning discipline and teamwork. Enroll today and experience the benefits of a program designed for both convenience and growth. Our After School Recreational Program is convenient for parents and fun for kids. We will pick up your child from school and bring them to our club after the school day has ended. Once students are checked in at our club, you will receive a text confirming their arrival. Each day, they will participate in taekwondo class.

blurb: At Chung's Taekwondo Richmond Hill, we are proud to offer a variety of programs designed to meet the needs of our community. Located conveniently at 9625 Yonge Street unit A, our academy focuses on providing high-quality martial arts instruction to kids, teens, and adults. With over 14 years of experience, Chung's Taekwondo has become a cornerstone in promoting fitness, discipline, and camaraderie in Richmond Hill.
